---
title: "People"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
# Put headshots in images/people/ named like the file below (for example shivam.jpg).
# If a photo is missing, the card shows the person's initials instead.
person <- function(name, role, photo = NULL, bio = "", class = "") {
  initials <- paste(substr(strsplit(name, " ")[[1]], 1, 1), collapse = "")
  img <- if (!is.null(photo) && file.exists(file.path("images/people", photo)))
    sprintf('<img src="images/people/%s" alt="%s">', photo, name) else
    sprintf('<div class="avatar">%s</div>', initials)
  htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
    '<div class="card person %s">%s<div><h4>%s</h4><p>%s</p>%s</div></div>',
    class, img, name, role, if (nzchar(bio)) paste0("<p>", bio, "</p>") else ""))
}
```
